activity.notes: After Pisa's defeat at Meloria, Ugolino was appointed podestà on 18 October 1284 and became the dominant ruler of the commune; the office of capitano del popolo was added in February 1285, and from 1286 he shared rule with Nino Visconti. He was overthrown and imprisoned on 1 July 1288. The combined role label avoids pretending that both formal offices began on the same day.

sources.title: GHERARDESCA, Ugolino della — Enciclopedia Italiana, Treccani
sources.citation_text: Treccani records Ugolino's appointment as podestà on 18 October 1284, the addition of capitano del popolo in February 1285, shared communal rule, and his imprisonment on 1 July 1288.
